title: Quietly Charred Argentinian Tomato Bowl
description: A charred, flaky, and lazy Sunday Argentinian dish featuring datterini tomatoes, served in a scallop shell vessel, and vegan friendly.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the halved datterini tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Arrange the tomatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the tomatoes are roasting, prepare the chimichurri sauce according to package instructions.
Once the tomatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Spoon the roasted tomatoes into the scallop shells.
Drizzle the chimichurri sauce over the tomatoes and serve immediately.
